Title: Echocardiographic Evaluation of Patent Ductus Arteriosus in Preterm Infants
Abstract: The hemodynamic transition, characterized by an elevated <m>pulmonary</m> <m>vascular</m> <m>resistance</m>, will be reflected on echocardiography by a predominantly <m>right</m>-to-<m>left</m> <m>shunt</m> in the first minutes of life, followed by a bidirectional <m>shunt</m> and later a <m>left</m>-to-<m>right</m> <m>shunt</m> with low ductal flow velocities.

Title: Decision-Making for Surgery in the Management of Patients with Univentricular Heart
